entities.name: Jenő Balogh
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jenő Balogh was a Hungarian politician and jurist, who served as Minister of Justice between 1913 and 1917. After the fall of the second István Tisza cabinet (1917) he retired from politics. He also served as General Secretary of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences from 1920 to 1935.

entities.summary: Jenő Balogh was a Hungarian politician and jurist, who served as Minister of Justice between 1913 and 1917. After the fall of the second István Tisza cabinet (1917) he retired from politics. He also served as General Secretary of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences from 1920 to 1935.
